name: eas-update
description: EAS service (paid). Configure and use EAS Update for over-the-air JavaScript and asset updates with expo-updates and EAS CLI. Use when setting up OTA updates, running eas update:configure or eas update, publishing to preview/staging/production channels, explaining branches/channels/runtime versions, testing updates, or debugging why an installed build still shows old code. Load for TestFlight, preview, or production updates that do not appear, including questions about cold launches or reopening
author: expo
summary_zh: 用于通过 EAS Update 和 expo-updates 发布及管理应用的 OTA 更新，适合配置预览、测试和生产渠道，以及排查更新未生效、版本或启动问题。
